profile.headline: Freelance Web Developer & Programmer • Occasional Marketer/works with SEO agencies • Sometimes Stand-Up Comic (Sometimes I Sit) • Let’s Chat 🤗
profile.summary:
Hello there! I’m a web developer and creative technologist with 5+ years of experience building fast, dynamic, and accessible websites for startups, agencies, and mission-driven brands.

My work spans front-end development (React, Next.js, WordPress, GSAP, Tailwind), SEO strategy, UI/UX design, and brand-focused storytelling. While my focus is on the front end, I also have experience working with backend technologies like Node.js, Express, and basic REST/GraphQL APIs. I’ve led web builds from the ground up, collaborated with cross-functional teams, and helped clients grow through intuitive, conversion-driven design and development.

I’m now looking for a full-time opportunity where I can bring my technical chops, creative energy, and a collaborative spirit to a team I believe in.

Let’s connect, would love to hear what you’re working on!🤓

Like many of my recent peers who graduated in an uncertain job market, this initiative is meant to provide marketing services to those in need during this volatile time. Please do not hesitate to reach out if assistance is needed, or just to say hello! Take care.

If you’d like to inquire, please message me for a portfolio and/or a meeting!

positions.title: Orientation Leader
positions.description:
Work consisted of a dynamic and changing environment with people from all walks of life who brought unique and thought-provoking perspectives every day. Working with 28 other individuals we were coached on communication tactics, resources and ways in which to be present and positively impact new students time at the University of Minnesota. Utilizing these crafted skills to lead and support a group of 20+ new students throughout a 24 hour time period.

Also developed public speaking skills through several presentations, two of which were with another colleague in front of 2,500+ new students to the university.
